review_questions: Check signed Delta/IV formulas, denominator edge cases, and target-end arithmetic independently.
Verify all model comparisons preserve identical row identities and chronological ordering.
Verify bootstrap null centering, p-value direction, Holm correction, deterministic settings and failure handling.
Check that the fit gate cannot be bypassed by an arbitrary Boolean/dict and is pinned to approved scope/code/preflight hashes.
Check end-to-end completeness: feature construction, artifact/schema preflight, daily/intraday row matching, 20-cell run, aggregate outputs and cleanup.
Return PASS_FOR_CODE_ONLY or REQUEST_CHANGES; do not authorize empirical data access or fitting.
